title: CCG Diffusion: Combinatory Categorial Grammar-Driven Compositional and Syntactically Disambiguated Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image generation models do not explicitly receive the syntactic structure of the prompt, i.e., which word modifies which and where each phrase attaches. Consequently, they often struggle to bind attributes to the correct objects, to depict spatial relations and counts correctly, and to render syntactically ambiguous prompts in the intended interpretation. Existing syntax-based control methods mainly address attribute binding and have limited ability to control spatial relations and counts or to specify the interpretation of syntactically ambiguous prompts. They rely on phrase-structure or dependency grammars and require additional rules or constraints on the tree structure to extract modification relations between words or to specify a syntactic interpretation. translated_title: CCG Diffusion：基于组合范畴语法的组合式且句法消歧的文生图生成
translated_abstract: 文生图生成模型并未显式接收提示词的句法结构，即哪个词修饰哪个词、每个短语附着于何处。因此，这些模型常常难以将属性绑定到正确的对象上、难以正确描绘空间关系和数量，也难以按照预期的解释来呈现具有句法歧义的提示词。现有的基于句法的控制方法主要解决属性绑定问题，在控制空间关系和数量、或指定句法歧义提示词的解释方面能力有限。它们依赖于短语结构语法或依存语法，需要在树结构上附加额外的规则或约束，才能提取词与词之间的修饰关系或指定句法解释。我们提出了CCG Diffusion，这是一种免训练的方法，利用组合范畴语法（CCG）来控制图像生成。在CCG中，每个词的类别携带丰富的……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了免训练的CCG Diffusion方法，利用组合范畴语法（CCG）中词类别所携带的丰富句法信息，在文生图生成中实现对属性绑定、空间关系、数量控制以及句法歧义提示词预期解释的精确控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CCG Diffusion, a training-free method that leverages the rich syntactic information carried by Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) word categories to precisely control attribute binding, spatial relations, counts, and the intended interpretation of syntactically ambiguous prompts in text-to-image generation.
